scope: Compact export of recorded measurements; detailed arrays removed, not a new experiment.

protocol.scope:
Matched XGBoost classification vs within-environment pairwise ranking.
Established objectives only: no new algorithm or theoretical guarantee claimed.
Protected UNSW suffix is never loaded. Two retrospective source mixtures, fixed
200000-row budget, one fit/config/seed, identical features and benign label budget.
protocol.score: Raw margins for classifiers and relevance scores for rankers; no probability-rounding artifacts.
protocol.weight_scope: Classifier balanced weights equalize environment/class loss mass. Ranker balanced weights are inverse query sizes. Those are distinct APIs, so compare complete training schemes, not identical weighted losses.
protocol.query_scope: One query per environment; query IDs are metadata, never model features.
protocol.chronology_note: Within-network chronological periods; UNSW2015 target with later source data is retrospective, ToN2019 target uses prior2015/2018 sources.
